headline: On October 28, 2025: Hurricane Melissa devastates Jamaica

Human-driven climate change intensified Melissa's destructive force
instagramCaption:
Hurricane Melissa makes a catastrophic landfall in Jamaica. \\[On October 28, 2025, Hurricane Melissa, with maximum sustained winds of 190 mph, made landfall near Black River, Jamaica, killing over 30 people. It tied the 1935 Labor Day hurricane as the most intense Atlantic hurricane to make landfall. Climate scientists concluded that human-driven climate change intensified the hurricane's destructive winds and rainfall. \\Why it matters: The event highlighted the increasing impact of climate change on extreme weather. \\What do you think can be done to mitigate such disasters? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
